title: Implicit Bias
comment: Implicit Bias — Mirror descent selects among the minimizers the one closest to initialization for the associated Bregman divergence (its "implicit bias"). Euclidean descent computes an orthogonal projection on the minimizers. https://arxiv.org/abs/1802.08246
alt_text: Implicit Bias. Mirror descent selects among the minimizers the one closest to initialization for the associated Bregman divergence (its "implicit bias"). Euclidean descent computes an orthogonal projection on the minimizers.

title: Histo Equaliz
